ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation starts from net earnings, adds income taxes (continuing ops), interest expense net, and REMOVES (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (shown in ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added), then adds DDA&A. Hence ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda differs from ebitda_pub by exactly ebitda_bridge_disc_ops; the check passes once that line is included. As originally reported (Q4-11 release), Adjusted EBITDA = EBITDA excluding only restructuring charges (12.971) and exchange offer evaluation costs (2.227), shown as one combined line (+15.2); split into adj_items restructuring / other from the income statement. Gains on sale (42.1 real estate/businesses) and the $46.4m recovery from legal settlement (insurance recovery related to the 2010 Illinois DOT/Lower Illinois lawsuit settlement) were NOT excluded in 2011's original definition. The FY2012 release recast 2011 Adjusted EBITDA to $351.8m (also removing legal recovery -46.4 and gain on sale of real estate and businesses -42.1). No adjusted EPS table; release narrative: full-year loss from continuing ops -$0.58 includes $0.06 restructuring and $0.01 exchange offer per share (eps_items_after_tax_ps 0.07 is the sum of those, not a published adjusted EPS). Release narrative: full-year EBITDA included $87m of gains from sale of non-strategic assets and the legal settlement.
